purpose: Two keyword parent hops from a Leaf static entry select the protected Base Generator; called Leaf scope survives both returned factories. A fresh equal-context sibling remains during actual close finally.

<?php
class Base76A {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base76A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf76A'), '|';
        try {
            yield 76;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
        return static::class;
    }
}
class Mid76A extends Base76A {
    public static function make() { echo 'MAKE|'; return parent::body(); }
}
class Leaf76A extends Mid76A {
    public static function outer() { echo 'OUTER|'; return parent::make(); }
}
$g = Leaf76A::outer();
$other = Leaf76A::outer();
echo 'MADE|';
$first = $g->current();
echo 'FIRST|', (int) ($first === 76), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'CLOSED|';
unset($other, $first);
echo 'E';

purpose: Four keyword hops select a Leaf late-static factory override, then Base self Generator; a shared reference parameter, copied first cache and resumed second yield retain called Leaf scope after all factories return.

<?php
class Base76B {
    protected static function body(&$slot) {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base76B'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf76B'), '|';
        yield $slot;
        echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($slot === 11), '|';
        yield $slot;
        return static::class;
    }
    public static function step(&$slot) { echo 'STEP|'; return self::body($slot); }
}
class Mid76B extends Base76B {
    public static function middle(&$slot) { echo 'MID|'; return parent::step($slot); }
}
class Leaf76B extends Mid76B {
    public static function outer(&$slot) { echo 'OUTER|'; return static::middle($slot); }
    public static function middle(&$slot) { echo 'LEAF|'; return parent::middle($slot); }
}
$slot = 5;
$g = Leaf76B::outer($slot);
$slot = 8;
echo 'MADE|';
$first = $g->current();
echo 'FIRST|', (int) ($first === 8), '|';
$slot = 11;
echo 'CACHE|', (int) ($g->current() === 8), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'SECOND|', (int) ($g->current() === 11), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 'Leaf76B'), '|';
unset($g, $slot, $first);
echo 'E';

purpose: An ordinary Leaf instance factory enters self static middle then static Leaf Generator. The root maker retires before Generator entry; borrowed chain provenance adds no receiver owner.

<?php
class Maker76C {
    public function start($item) { echo 'START|'; return self::middle($item); }
    protected static function middle($item) { echo 'MIDDLE|'; return static::body($item); }
    protected static function body($item) { echo 'BAD|'; yield $item; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER-DROP|'; }
}
class Leaf76C extends Maker76C {
    protected static function body($item) {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Leaf76C'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf76C'), '|';
        yield $item;
        return 76;
    }
}
$maker = new Leaf76C();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$input = 5;
$g = $maker->start($input);
unset($maker);
$input = 9;
echo 'RETIRED|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
$value = $g->current();
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 5), '|', (int) ($input === 9), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'DONE|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 76), '|';
unset($g, $weakMaker, $input, $value);
echo 'E';
